name: MonarchDomainProgress
title: DomainProgress
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column and Row drawn as a vertical stepper; androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator for the step in progress; MonarchInlineNotice for problems; android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString for the last check
summary: Stage-by-stage progress for connecting a custom domain (DNS record found, HTTPS certificate issued, live), with the problems the product found, what public DNS shows right now and that checking continues on its own.
whenToUse: On a custom domain screen after the user added DNS records, to show where the connection stands and what to fix, while the app polls the product.
whenNotToUse: For the records themselves, use MonarchDnsRecordTable; for a general multi-step flow the user moves through, use MonarchStepper.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDomainProgress(host: String, stage: MonarchDomainStage, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, problems: List<MonarchDomainProblem> = emptyList(), dnsFound: MonarchDomainDnsSnapshot? = null, checkedAt: Long? = null, now: Long? = null, rechecking: Boolean = true, notify: MonarchDomainNotify? = null, labels: MonarchDomainProgressLabels = MonarchDomainProgressLabels())
object MonarchDomainProgressDefaults { fun recheckIntervalMillis(stage: MonarchDomainStage?, suggestedMillis: Long? = null, stopped: Boolean = false): Long? }
enum class MonarchDomainStage { Dns, Ownership, Certificate, Page, Live }
enum class MonarchDomainStep { Dns, Certificate, Live }
enum class MonarchDomainStepState { Done, Current, Todo, Error }
class MonarchDomainProblem(message: String, code: String? = null, severity: MonarchDomainProblemSeverity = MonarchDomainProblemSeverity.Blocking, step: MonarchDomainStep? = null)
class MonarchDomainDnsSnapshot(cnames: List<String> = emptyList(), a: List<String> = emptyList(), aaaa: List<String> = emptyList())

class MonarchDomainProgressLabels(title: ((step: MonarchDomainStep, state: MonarchDomainStepState, stage: MonarchDomainStage) -> String)? = null, detail: ((step: MonarchDomainStep, state: MonarchDomainStepState, host: String) -> String)? = null, state: ((state: MonarchDomainStepState) -> String)? = null, listLabel: ((host: String) -> String)? = null, announcement: ((position: Int, count: Int, title: String, state: String) -> String)? = null, dnsSeen: ((host: String, seen: String) -> String)? = null, noRecord: String? = null, rechecking: ((notify: MonarchDomainNotify?) -> String)? = null, checked: ((time: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: host
options.description: The custom host name, such as book.example.com. Used in the live step text, the DNS line and the group name.

options.name: stage
options.description: Dns or Ownership: the DNS step is in progress. Certificate: DNS done, certificate in progress. Page: certificate done, the site load check in progress. Live: every step done.

options.name: problems
options.description: What the last check found. A blocking problem marks its step (the current one by default) as needing attention and is shown as a warning notice; when there is none, the first informational problem is shown as a neutral notice.

options.name: dnsFound
options.description: What public DNS shows for the host right now, shown as "Public DNS for <host> shows CNAME → …" or "no record yet". null hides the line.

options.name: checkedAt
options.description: When the product last checked, as epoch milliseconds (UTC). Shown as "Checked 2 minutes ago."

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for checkedAt, as epoch milliseconds. null is the current time, refreshed every minute; pass a fixed time in tests and screenshots.

options.name: rechecking
options.description: Whether the product keeps checking on its own; adds "We keep checking automatically…".

options.name: notify
options.description: How the product tells the user it went live: Email or InApp changes the end of the rechecking sentence.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string: step titles and details, spoken states, the group name, the announcement, the DNS line, the rechecking sentence and the last check line.

states.name: done
states.description: The step marker is the success fill with a check mark, and the line after it is the success color.

states.name: current
states.description: The step marker is the accent fill with a spinner; when animations are off the spinner is a still dot.

states.name: todo
states.description: The step marker is an empty surface circle with the default border, and the title is muted.

states.name: error
states.description: A blocking problem: the step marker is the warning fill with an exclamation mark, and the problem is shown as a warning notice.

states.name: live
states.description: Every step is done and the DNS, rechecking and last check lines are hidden.

appearance: Markers are 24dp circles (larger at large font scales) with a 2dp border: success, accent or warning solid fills with their on-solid glyph color, or the surface color with the default border. The line between markers is 2dp, the success color after a finished step and the default border otherwise. Titles are strong body text, muted before the step starts; details and status lines are muted caption text. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Built as its own vertical stepper rather than on MonarchStepper, as on iOS, because MonarchStepper always draws a current step (it cannot show every step done once live) and has no in-progress spinner; the plan's dependency on stepper is therefore not used. The spinner is the Material 3 CircularProgressIndicator. Monarch bundles no icons, so the check and exclamation marks are drawn as the web's SVG strokes, as MonarchStepper does. The web's rich-content messages (dnsSeen, checked) take and return strings, and the host is not set in code font inside the sentence. The web's polling helper domainPollMs is MonarchDomainProgressDefaults.recheckIntervalMillis, returning milliseconds (iOS returns a Duration from a static function on the view). Times are epoch milliseconds. iOS uses the same names, except rechecking (iOS isRechecking), stopped (iOS isStopped) and the PascalCase enum constants.
accessibility: The steps are one group named "Progress for <host>".
Each step is one element: its title as the name and "<state>, <detail>" as the state description, such as "in progress, Being issued now, usually 1 to 5 minutes."
The state is a spoken word and a glyph in the marker, not only a color; markers are hidden from TalkBack.

When the active step or its state changes, "Step 2 of 3: HTTPS certificate, in progress." is announced through a polite live region that is always present; nothing is announced when the view first appears.
Problems are MonarchInlineNotice, which speaks the tone name with the message.
When animations are off, the in-progress marker is a still dot.
Text wraps and the marker grows with the font scale.
edgeCases: A blocking problem on a step that is already done does not change it.
A blocking problem without a step marks the current step; with several problems all blocking ones are shown and informational ones are hidden.
Long host names wrap in the step details and the DNS line.
The view never checks DNS itself; the app polls and passes the new stage.
The relative time uses DateUtils, in the device locale.

examples.title: Issuing the certificate
examples.template:
MonarchDomainProgress(
    host = {{host}},
    stage = MonarchDomainStage.{{stage|pascal}},
    dnsFound = MonarchDomainDnsSnapshot(cnames = listOf({{dnsFound.cnames.0}})),
    checkedAt = {{checkedAt|millis}},
    now = {{now|millis}},
    notify = MonarchDomainNotify.{{notify|pascal}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDomainProgress(
    host = "book.example.com",
    stage = MonarchDomainStage.Certificate,
    dnsFound = MonarchDomainDnsSnapshot(cnames = listOf("domains.example.net")),
    checkedAt = 1_768_046_280_000L,
    now = 1_768_046_400_000L,
    notify = MonarchDomainNotify.Email,
)

examples.title: A record that points somewhere else
examples.code:
MonarchDomainProgress(
    host = "book.example.com",
    stage = MonarchDomainStage.Dns,
    problems = listOf(MonarchDomainProblem("Your domain points somewhere else. Remove the A record for book.")),
    dnsFound = MonarchDomainDnsSnapshot(a = listOf("203.0.113.10")),
)
